en: I'm going over this wreck for Captain Stern. He asked me to look for a Scanner, too, but I haven't had any luck...
Is that a Scanner? Wonderful! Could you take it to Captain Stern in Slateport for me?
I'd like to stay and look around this ship a little longer.
This ship was called the S.S. Cactus. It seems to be from long before my time.
